create_tracks_manager: create a TracksManager instance to manage MPS point visibility tracks across camera channels
update_tracks_and_remove_old_observation: update tracks for a camera label with new UV coordinates and remove stale observations
get_track_for_camera_label: get or create the track dictionary for a given camera label string
add_point_to_track: add a new point to a track dictionary and trim history to max track length
remove_non_visible_observations: remove track entries that are no longer visible from the currently visible point UIDs set
